description: Jet 4 MDB: DAO Recordset Field.Value assignment conversions on TC(ID PK, B BYTE, I SMALLINT, L LONG, S SINGLE, D DOUBLE, C CURRENCY, DT DATETIME, Y YESNO, DC DECIMAL(18,4), T TEXT(40), M MEMO, G GUID): Step 1 valid text-to-scalar/date/currency/boolean/decimal & half-to-even rounding; Step 2 numeric/date/bool/currency-to-Text/Memo; Step 3 Null into Yes/No, Empty into all column types, Missing into Long/Text; Step 4 bad text ('abc', '') & overflows into Byte/Integer/Long/Single/Double/Currency/DateTime/YesNo/Decimal/GUID + non-BSTR into GUID. Keeps all pages before/after setup, writes, and Close; reads back persisted rows.

args.text: CREATE TABLE TC (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TC PRIMARY KEY, B BYTE, I SMALLINT, L INTEGER, S REAL, D FLOAT, C CURRENCY, DT DATETIME, Y BIT, DC DECIMAL(18,4), T TEXT(40), M MEMO, G GUID)
SELECT ID, B, I, L, S, D, C, DT, Y, DC, CStr(DC) AS DCStr, T, M, G FROM TC ORDER BY ID
